summary_files.results/summary.jsonl: per-file results, one line per program per major (scope: single_file), each produced by a tsconfig.one.json that includes only that file. The article's exit-code table is built from these 12 lines.
summary_files.results/project_runs.jsonl: whole-project runs: one tsc -p tsconfig.json per major (scope: whole_project) plus the npm install exit codes. Every whole-project run exits 2 because legacy.tsx is in the same include set, so these lines are not usable as per-file results.
summary_files.results/probes.jsonl: one line per single-symbol probe (scope: probe).

not_run: No network model calls: no API key was used, so no token was generated and no response was streamed from a provider. All results are TypeScript compile results only.
No runtime execution, no bundler build, no React render, no Next.js app. Only tsc --noEmit.
Runtime behaviour of the legacy surface was not exercised: the compile errors stop type-checking, so 'throws at runtime' is not asserted.
reproduce: bash run_matrix.sh (self-contained: requires TMPDIR, creates $TMPDIR/mx/v5..v7, copies programs/package.v*.json and programs/v*/ into them, npm install, then one tsc per file; writes results/summary.jsonl, results/project_runs.jsonl, results/probes.jsonl, results/npm-ls-v*.json and the raw logs)
